## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, …) and is lowercase
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or it needs none
- [ ] The README describes the change, and the header comment of each touched `lib/` file is up to date
- [ ] The roadmap is updated if this completes a roadmap item
- [ ] Tested in a real terminal with a temporary configuration (`DEV_WORKSPACE_CONFIG`), if the change affects what the CLI shows or does
